name: cx-siren
task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Go to the exit' is an unconditional command, correctly captured by hard Existence(at_exit), and 'whenever the siren rings, turn it off' is a 'whenever' rule correctly captured by hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) (switch_toggled is the consequent event, not a goal, so no Existence for it). Both propositions are grounded, both clauses are hard as the wording demands, and neither is redundant or added.

texts: The agent must reach the exit at least once.
Whenever the siren is ringing, the agent must toggle the switch at that step or later to turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!siren_ringing) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&switch_toggled) -> u2
(u1, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u2
(u3, switch_toggled) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1

(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&switch_toggled, u2) -> 11

(u1, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u3) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&switch_toggled, u2) -> 12
(u3, switch_toggled, u2) -> 11
